summary: Feed s060_single is degraded: 50% of packets are untagged and required VLAN 20 is missing. APM will have incomplete segmentation/coverage for VLAN 20.

findings.root_cause: Upstream TAP/SPAN trunk or packet broker policy is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20. 50% untagged packets indicates tags are being removed (native VLAN mismatch or 'strip tags' enabled) or VLAN 20 is pruned from the monitored trunk.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM requires VLANs 10 and 20 to segment and correlate application transactions. With VLAN 20 absent and half the traffic untagged, the APM cannot correctly attribute performance metrics per segment, creating a blind spot for VLAN 20 and misclassifying untagged flows.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving and forwarding 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the TAP/SPAN and packet broker ensures the APM receives complete, correctly-tagged traffic and restores visibility to the 50% currently untagged.
